name: lang
description: Languages you hear and speak, on this machine (no cloud). Speech is transcribed with per-phrase language detection ([speech ru] … [en] …); voices speak each language. lang_install(lang) learns a language: downloads its verified voice and enables it (do it without asking when [new language heard: …] arrives or someone speaks or asks for a language; tell them you are learning it first). lang_list shows what is learned; lang_catalog(query) lists languages (~99 heard, ~42 spoken) and voices; lang_voice picks a voice; lang_preview makes a sample to send; lang_default sets the default language; lang_input sets how a language is typed on the console (a learned language gets its keyboard on its own); lang_disable stops a language and its new-language notices; lang_remove deletes it (ask first). lang_transcribe(file) transcribes any recording; lang_synthesize(text, lang) makes an audio file. lang_settings: noise suppression, pause splitting, hallucination filter, discovery, echo filter, speaker check, and the Whisper model for calls and voice notes. lang_enroll saves a voice print for the opt-in speaker check.
examples: system|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[new language heard: es (Spanish), not installed yet. …] -> say(channel='telegram:123', message='I hear Spanish — learning it now, one moment.'); discover(path='mcp/lang', enable=true); lang_install(lang='es')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|which languages do you know? -> lang_list()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|use a male Russian voice -> lang_catalog(query='ru'); lang_voice(lang='ru', voice='piper-ru_RU-dmitri-medium')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|let me type German with umlauts -> lang_input(lang='de', input='keyboard-de')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|let me hear the German voice -> lang_preview(lang='de'); say(files=['speech/previews/…'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|forget French -> ask first; then lang_remove(lang='fr')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|voice notes are badly transcribed -> lang_settings(file_model='whisper-small')
